reason: Honestly I'd download it, build like three apps on the free plan, have fun for a week, and then drift back to my notes app like I always do. Five apps and 50 actions is plenty for a week of playing around, so I'd never hit the paywall before I lose interest.
objection: I already pay for a budgeting app that works, and I've ditched every productivity app I've ever tried. Paying another $6 a month on my budget for something I'll probably abandon feels dumb.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually replaced my budgeting app so I could cancel that subscription, and I was still opening it every day after a month on the free plan.
